chunks: When those young men took shelter in the cave, and prayed: 'O Lord, grant us Your favour and dispose our affair aright,'
ai.seo_question: What was the prayer of the youths of the cave?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the transition of the young men from physical refuge to spiritual reliance, emphasizing that true 'rashad' (guidance/direction) is a divine gift rather than merely human effort. The supplication underscores the principle that divine mercy (rahmah) precedes and enables the rectification of one's affairs, a concept central to the Shia understanding of God's grace (fadl) and guidance (hidayah).
